purpose: Behavioral regression scenarios for the skill instructions. Expected outcomes are criteria, not claims of completed model evaluations.

scenarios.request: Explain likely architecture choices for this benchmark; do not run experiments.
expected: Read available benchmark evidence
No runtime initialization, HLS command, or worker spawning
State missing evidence without blocking the explanation

scenarios.request: Optimize this identified benchmark as fast as possible for one round.
scenarios.context: Device, types, tests, and clock candidates are already specified.
expected: No mandatory numeric latency-budget question
Record latency as a soft objective
Create missing authorized state and all three seed roles

scenarios.request: Run two rounds, but do not run implementation.
expected: One consistent cosim_only_user_override policy
No impl or all call at any retry/clock
Provisional results, null routed metrics, no formal Pareto promotion
Two rounds unless a real blocker or limit prevents completion

scenarios.context: Synthesis uses 2.5x the predicted DSP but meets all actual constraints; forecast II was optional.
expected: Diagnose and correct the estimate
No mandatory source edit or synthesis rerun
Continue policy-required validation

scenarios.context: An authorized new run has zero parents; a later population has one.
expected: All three roles retained
Zero-parent seed and one-parent seed_variant explicitly labeled
No invented crossover parent

scenarios.request: Initialize requirements and choose an architecture.
expected: Parser proposal precedes Architect proposal
Only Main promotes to state and knowledge
Literature ideas remain labeled hypotheses

scenarios.context: Comparable HV changes fall below 2% in the first three comparisons.
expected: Do not stop merely for low improvement
No per-round reapproval
Respect the existing finite execution limits

scenarios.request: Continue until converged, at most six rounds.
scenarios.context: Optional pymoo is unavailable or formal population is empty.
expected: Available status still reported
No dependency installation or fabricated HV
No convergence claim
Continue feasible work within six rounds and report the real termination reason

scenarios.context: Exploiter proposes FP32-to-FP16 while benchmark requires FP32 behavior.
expected: Preserve FP32 unless numerical change already authorized
Do not relax reference tests or tolerance
Continue with contract-preserving alternatives

scenarios.context: A user requests publication of the generic skill while the active project contains private experiments and learned knowledge.
expected: Review an explicit allowlist of generic skill resources
Exclude project inputs, knowledge bases, reports, archives, and machine-specific configuration
Do not treat permission to publish the skill as permission to disclose project-derived artifacts

scenarios.context: Kernel header or config changed after synthesis.
expected: Reject stale synthesis receipt before cosim/impl
Rerun required stages within the same assignment budget
Archive immutable inputs and evidence before workspace reuse

scenarios.context: Four independently material blockers remain after inspecting project evidence.
expected: Retain all four blockers
Ask at most three at a time
Do not treat estimate confidence or an optional priority as an additional blocker
